<infobox>
  <title source="title1">
    <default>{{PAGENAME}}</default>
  </title>
    <panel name="img">
        <section name="section1">
            <label>{{{skin1|Original Skin}}}</label>
			<image source="image1">
				  <caption source="caption1"/>
				</image>
        </section>
        <section name="section2">
            <label>{{{skin2|Shiny Skin}}}</label>
				<image source="image2">
					<default>{{#ifexist:File:{{PAGENAME}} Shiny (Pose).png|{{PAGENAME}} Shiny (Pose).png|{{#invoke:UnitData2|CheckIMG_TowerInfobox}} Shiny (Pose).png}}</default>
					<caption source="caption2"/>
				</image>
        </section>
        <section name="section3">
            <label>{{{skin3}}}</label>
				<image source="image3">
					<caption source="caption3"/>
				</image>
        </section>
   </panel>
  <data source="deployment_cost">
    <label>Deployment Cost</label>
    <format><span class="game-font-face" style="text-shadow: 0 0 3px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black;color: #ffc608;">{{formatnum:{{{deployment_cost}}}}}¥</span></format>
    <default>{{#iferror:<span class="game-font-face" style="text-shadow: 0 0 3px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black;color: #ffc608;">{{formatnum: {{#invoke:UnitData2|get|Akoku (Destruction)|cost}}}}¥</span>|}}</default>
  </data>
  <data source="upgrade_levels">
    <label>Upgrade Levels</label>
    <default>{{#iferror:{{#invoke:UnitData2|get|Akoku (Destruction)|upgrade_levels}}|}}</default>
  </data>
    <data source="spawn_cap">
    <label>Spawn Cap</label>
    <default>{{#iferror:{{#invoke:UnitData2|get|Akoku (Destruction)|spawn_cap}}|}}</default>
  </data>
  <data source="total_cost">
    <label>Total Cost</label>
    <format><span class="game-font-face" style="text-shadow: 0 0 3px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black;color: #ffc608;">{{formatnum:{{{total_cost}}}}}¥</span></format>
    <default>{{#iferror:<span class="game-font-face" style="text-shadow: 0 0 3px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black, 0 0 2px black;color: #ffc608;">{{formatnum:{{#invoke:UnitData2|get|Akoku (Destruction)|total_cost}}}}¥</span>|}}</default>
  </data>
  <data source="Tower_type">
    <label>Tower Type</label>
    <default>{{#iferror:{{formatnum:{{#invoke:UnitData2|get|Akoku (Destruction)|tower_type}}}}|}}</default>
  </data>
  <data source="Traits">
    <label>Traits</label>
    <default>{{Trait}}</default>
  </data>
  <group>
    <header>Attack Stats</header>
    <data source="Attack_Type">
      <label>Attack Type</label>
    <default>{{#iferror:{{formatnum:{{#invoke:UnitData2|get|Akoku (Destruction)|attack_type}}}}|}}</default>
    </data>
    <data source="damage">
		<label>Damage</label>
		<default>{{#iferror:{{formatnum: {{#invoke:UnitData2|get|Akoku (Destruction)|damage}} }} {{#ifeq:{{#invoke:UnitData2|get|Akoku (Destruction)|damage}}|{{#invoke:UnitData2|get|Akoku (Destruction)|upgrade|damage|max}}|Akoku (Destruction)|-> {{formatnum:{{#invoke:UnitData2|get|Akoku (Destruction)|upgrade|damage|max}} }}}}|}}</default>
    </data>
    <data source="seconds_per_attack">
      <label>Attack Rate/SPA</label>
      <default>{{#iferror:{{formatnum: {{#invoke:UnitData2|get|Akoku (Destruction)|attack_cooldown}} }} {{#ifeq:{{#invoke:UnitData2|get|Akoku (Destruction)|attack_cooldown}}|{{#invoke:UnitData2|get|Akoku (Destruction)|upgrade|attack_cooldown|max}}|Akoku (Destruction)|-> {{formatnum:{{#invoke:UnitData2|get|Akoku (Destruction)|upgrade|attack_cooldown|max}} }}}}|}}</default>
    </data>
    <data source="range">
    	<label>Range</label>
    	<default>{{#iferror:{{formatnum: {{#invoke:UnitData2|get|Akoku (Destruction)|range}} }} {{#ifeq:{{#invoke:UnitData2|get|Akoku (Destruction)|range}}|{{#invoke:UnitData2|get|Akoku (Destruction)|upgrade|range|max}}|Akoku (Destruction)|-> {{formatnum: {{#invoke:UnitData2|get|Akoku (Destruction)|upgrade|range|max}} }}}}|}}</default>
	</data>
  </group>
</infobox>
